title: Path with Art

services.name: Virtual Exhibition
services.desc: In ecology, estuaries are transitional places where freshwater meets saltwater. These are the nurseries of the sea-where the story-laden silt of mountains and rivers meet and mingle with the deep knowledge of the oceans. In the spirit of the estuary, Path with Art invites you to dip your senses into the teeming waters of experience and emotion. Here, the rich sediment of artists’ inner lives washes over paper and canvas, fabric and form, combining together into a creative habitat overflowing with inspiration.
